output:
- Tank stock confirmed as of 2023/05/28: 10 neon tetras, 5 golden honey gouramis, small pleco in 20-gal (s1-m0).
- Aggression concern now framed as protecting neon tetras, not gourami-vs-gourami; has artificial coral and rocks already (s1-m8).
- Considering adding treasure chest or sunken ship decoration for more hiding spots — question pending as of 2023/05/28 (s1-m8).
- Focused on Java Moss and Anacharis as live plant picks; received care guidance (lighting, pH, fertilizing, gentle/moderate flow, copper-sensitivity) (s1-m2, s1-m3).
- Lemon tetras vs zebra danios still under consideration; advised school of 6-10, watch gourami fin-nipping (s1-m4, s1-m5).
- Received decoration ideas (rock caves, driftwood, tunnels, coconut shells) and aquascaping guidance (focal point, balance, open swim space) (s0-m11, s1-m6, s1-m7).
- Earlier plans retained: beginner plants, nutrient substrate, bloodworm treats 1-2x/week for Bubbles (s0-m0, s0-m8, s0-m9).
